services.name: Carriage Rides
services.desc: Meet at the stables, located at 4377 Northwest Dr., across from the tennis center. The carriage will not operate on days where the temperature is 93 degrees or above, or where the temperature is 15 degrees or below. Carriage will also not operate if snow, ice, heavy rain, or other conditions makes footing unsafe for the horse. Note: When making a reservation, please select the time you would like to begin the carriage ride. Reservations are available up to 90 days in the future.
